import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

df = pd.read_csv('data/customer_segments.csv')

# Select relevant columns
spending_cols = ['MntWines', 'MntFruits', 'MntMeatProducts', 'MntFishProducts', 'MntSweetProducts', 'MntGoldProds']
df_melt = df.melt(id_vars=['Education'], value_vars=spending_cols, 
                  var_name='Spending_Category', value_name='Amount')

# Group by Education and Spending_Category, compute mean
df_grouped = df_melt.groupby(['Education', 'Spending_Category'])['Amount'].mean().reset_index()

# Sort Education levels for better visualization (optional)
education_order = sorted(df['Education'].unique())
df_grouped['Education'] = pd.Categorical(df_grouped['Education'], categories=education_order, ordered=True)

# Plot
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
sns.barplot(x='Education', y='Amount', hue='Spending_Category', data=df_grouped)
plt.title('Average Spending by Education Level and Category')
plt.xlabel('Education Level')
plt.ylabel('Average Amount Spent')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.legend(title='Spending Category', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
